items.t: Día de los Muertos Market Returns to Lakeland Nov. 1
items.x: The second annual Día de los Muertos Market will be held at Haus 820 on Sunday, Nov. 1, from noon to 5 p.m.

items.t: Armed citizens hold knife-wielding woman at gunpoint at Polk County Dollar General: sheriff
items.x: A woman who threatened customers at a Polk County Dollar General with a knife was arrested after two armed citizens held her at gunpoint until deputies arrived, according to the sheriff's office.

items.t: Knife-wielding woman in Polk store held by two citizens at gunpoint: PCSO
items.x: A Kissimmee woman armed with a knife inside a Polk County discount store was arrested after two armed citizens held her at gunpoint, officials said.

items.t: Polk County’s Nonpartisan School Board Race Draws Partisan Support
items.x: In the District 3 runoff, political parties and PACs are financing campaign messages and supporting candidates in the race between Kate Wallace and Victor Sims.

items.t: South Florida Avenue Reconstruction Expected to Take More Than 3 Years
items.x: Lakeland’s $26.3 million project will bring wider sidewalks, improved crossings and a permanent three-lane design to Dixieland.

items.t: More Voting Myths, Debunked
items.x: Early voting begins Oct. 19, in Polk County. In part three of our series demystifying and debunking myths and misinformation about Florida elections, we're tackling the truth about vote by mail and polling places.

items.t: LPD Hosts National Prescription Drug Take Back Day Saturday
items.x: From 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. on Oct. 24, the Lakeland Police Department will host a drive-through drop-off for unwanted, unneeded, or expired medication.

items.t: Registration for LPD’s Cops for Kids Begins Oct. 26 and 27
items.x: The program has provided Christmas gifts and nurtured positive relationships with thousands of Lakeland children since it began in 2007.

items.t: Polk Disables Public Comments on County-Run Social Media Accounts
items.x: On Tuesday, Oct. 20, Polk County commissioners reached a unanimous vote to disable comments on all 21 county-run social media accounts, a decision that county officials say will curb misinformation and cut down on vulgarity.

items.t: More Than Candy: Why Lakeland Churches Go Big on Fall Festivals
items.x: From sensory-friendly activities to massive trunk-or-treats, Lakeland churches offer family fun while building community connections.

items.t: 35th Annual Red Ribbon Run Coming Saturday, Oct. 31
items.x: The 35 annual Red Ribbon Run, promoting healthy, substance-free living, returns to Lake Mirror this Saturday, Oct. 31.

items.t: Polk Supervisor of Elections Debunks Social Media Ballot Rumors
items.x: LkldNow asks Melony Bell about social media claims that ballots might be rejected if written on by poll workers.

items.t: Ad calling Moody the ‘deciding vote’ on Epstein files misses context, later support
Patrick Stewart has died at age 86
items.x: The actor died at his home in Los Angeles following a "brief and poignant journey" with Alzheimer's Disease and Lewy Body Dementia.

items.t: Patrick Stewart, stage giant also of ‘Star Trek’ and 'X-Men' fame, dies at 86
items.x: Patrick Stewart, the classically trained stage actor who scaled the Shakespearean canon and added gravitas to a “Star Trek” franchise and the “X-Men” films, has died. He was 86.

items.t: Murder trial resumes for man accused of killing roommate, dumping her remains | How to watch
items.x: The murder trial of Robert Kessler is underway in Hillsborough County. You can stream it live daily on the free 10 Tampa Bay News app.

items.t: Sir Patrick Stewart of 'X-Men,' 'Star Trek' dies after Alzheimer's battle
items.x: Sir Patrick Stewart has died after a battle with Alzheimer's, according to his family.

items.t: Dartmouth official resigns over AI use
items.x: A top Dartmouth official has resigned from his position after allegations that he violated the school's AI use policy.

items.t: Florida brain tumor patient says nearly $1 million in medical bills are now covered after insurance denial
items.x: Five months after an insurance fight over brain surgery, Broqsten Bunt says he is medically cleared and has a zero balance on nearly $1 million in billed care.

items.t: Insurance rates to decrease for over 800K Florida homeowners, officials say
items.x: Over 824,300 Florida homeowners will receive rate decreases on their new policies or renewals after multiple rate-decrease requests from major insurance companies took effect in October.
